title: GridGame skill hexagon (skill-hex)
description: The one board every hero is built on: six stat corners, six family wedges, a hexagonal lattice of ability slots each ringed by stat passives, and every hero as a starting path. Read by docs/design/skill-hexagon (the page) and by the game (ContentLoader). Hand-editable: one node or hero per line.

Version.description: Bumped whenever a change needs a save migration (moved or removed nodes).

Radius.description: Lattice radius N in axial coordinates: every point with |Q|, |R| and |Q+R| at most N exists. N=16 gives 817 points.

Stats.description: The six identity stats, clockwise from the top corner.

Families.description: Family k is the wedge from corner k (From) to corner k+1 (To).

Passive.description: Skill points to take a passive node.

Ability.description: Skill points to take an ability node.

PlannerPassThroughAbility.description: Route weight the planner and bots give to walking through an ability you did not aim for, so routes prefer passives.

Nodes.description: Every lattice point exactly once. Ability slots are the points where (Q - R) mod 3 = 0; every other point is a passive, so each ability is ringed by six passives.

Stats.description: Passive bonus, e.g. {"VIT": 2} or {"VIT": 1, "STR": 1}. Kind Passive only.

Note.description: Designer note, e.g. what an Open slot is reserved for (future content or DLC).

Heroes.description: Every hero class: its place on the stat hexagon, its signature move and the path of nodes it joins the party with.

Class.description: classes.json id; null for a planned hero that does not exist yet.

Recipe.description: 4-point stat recipe that places the hero on the stat hexagon, e.g. {"INT": 2, "VIT": 2} for Paladin.

Status.description: Cut: leaves the roster (saves convert it). New: a slot waiting for a hero.

Signature.description: abilities.json id of the move only this hero starts with; reaching it on the board is reaching this hero's identity.

Start.description: Lattice points [Q, R] this hero owns when it joins: a connected path or tree through its starting moves and passives.
